topic: Snow leopard: lives high in the mountains, including Pakistan's north; its thick tail helps it balance and keeps its face warm like a scarf.

episode.title: Wild Superpowers: Snow Leopard’s Amazing Tail!

shots.narration: Did you know a snow leopard carries its own scarf?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated mountain landscape; a cute, true-to-life snow leopard rests on a snowy rock, without text.
shots.action: The snow leopard curls its thick tail across its nose.
shots.mood: Sunny snow, soft silver fur, intriguing close-up.

shots.narration: Kiko and Pip explore high in Pakistan’s northern mountains.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny rocky mountain overlook beneath snowy peaks; Kiko wears his green safari hat and khaki pocketed vest, with emerald-green Pip beside him.
shots.action: Kiko raises his big binoculars toward a distant snow leopard.
shots.mood: Bright natural colours, vast peaks, eager discovery.

shots.narration: [excited] Snow leopards live high in mountains, including Pakistan’s north.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, realistic 3D alpine terrain with steep rocks and scattered snow beneath a blue sky.
shots.action: The snow leopard walks along a high rocky ridge.
shots.mood: Sunlit stone, sparkling snow, peaceful mountain grandeur.

shots.narration: But this rocky path looks tricky!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko and Pip watch from a broad safe overlook; beyond them, a snow leopard faces an uneven rock ledge.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the uneven ledge.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, rugged rocks, gentle suspense.

shots.narration: Its thick tail helps it balance.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, side view of a true-to-life snow leopard on a rocky mountain ledge, its long thick tail fully visible.
shots.action: The snow leopard crosses the uneven ledge with its tail extended.
shots.mood: Clear sunlight, graceful movement, reassuring confidence.

shots.narration: [excited] Across it goes, with help from that amazing tail!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, a broad sunlit rock shelf at the end of the uneven mountain ledge.
shots.action: The snow leopard steps onto the broad shelf.
shots.mood: Open space, warm sunshine, satisfying arrival.

shots.narration: And when resting, its tail keeps its face warm.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sheltered snowy mountain hollow, close view of a resting snow leopard with detailed thick fur.
shots.action: The snow leopard wraps its thick tail over its face.
shots.mood: Soft light, tucked paws, cozy calm.

shots.narration: A balancing helper and a cozy scarf!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny mountain overlook with Kiko and Pip in the foreground and the resting snow leopard far beyond.
shots.mood: Broad smile, shimmering green feathers, cheerful discovery.

shots.narration: [whispers] Next, an ocean animal with eight arms. Can you guess?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko and Pip on the mountain overlook beside a shallow, clear snowmelt pool reflecting the blue sky; no other animal visible.
shots.action: Kiko peers into the clear pool through his binoculars.
shots.mood: Playful curiosity, glittering water, inviting mystery.

episode.endHook: Next comes an ocean animal with eight arms. Can you guess?
episode.description: Discover how a snow leopard’s thick tail helps it balance and keeps its face warm like a scarf. Join Kiko and Pip high in the mountains, including Pakistan’s north!
